verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents end-to-end encryption on every field of user items (docs-10). That implies the vendor structurally cannot read vault contents, and so could not train AI on them. However, the pack contains no explicit AI-training policy, no statement that user data is excluded from model training, and no user-facing opt-out. Missing for 10: an explicit no-AI-training policy or commitment, a user control or opt-out for AI training, and coverage of non-vault data such as telemetry and metadata.
